description: Victorian mahogany bookcase on a cupboard base, front -Y, 1.00 W x 0.38 D x 2.00 H m: plinth with a moulded top, two-door cupboard (fielded panels, turned knobs) to 0.82 m with a projecting ledge, four open shelves above (bottoms at 0.84, 1.11, 1.38, 1.65 m) filled with cloth- and leather-bound books (gilt spine bands, a few stacks lying flat, end books leaning), panelled back, ogee cornice at the top. Pair with a wall behind; the back is flat.
